title: Identity Basics: IAM, Principals, and Service Accounts — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Workload Identity authentication: shows how a GKE Kubernetes ServiceAccount (KSA) securely exchanges tokens for a Google ServiceAccount (GSA) without service account keys.
routing_rationale: Workload Identity eliminates downloaded JSON keys. The GKE metadata server intercepts STS token exchanges, dynamically issuing short-lived Google OAuth tokens.

nodes.label: App Container (KSA: web-sa)
nodes.detail: Container running inside GKE Autopilot pod with mounted KSA token.

nodes.label: GKE Metadata Concealment
nodes.detail: Blocks access to legacy instance metadata; enforces Workload Identity exclusively.

nodes.label: Google STS Token Broker
nodes.detail: Verifies OIDC JSON Web Key Sets (JWKS) signature emitted by GKE cluster.

nodes.label: IAM Credentials API
nodes.detail: Generates 1-hour Google OAuth bearer access token for mapped GSA.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL / Secret Manager
nodes.detail: Consumes verified OAuth token to release encrypted database credentials.

steps.title: Metadata Interception
steps.action: Application client invokes Google Cloud SDK; SDK queries 169.254.169.254.
steps.why_traversal: Zero code modification required; SDK natively detects metadata server.

steps.title: OIDC Token Validation
steps.action: STS broker validates Kubernetes cluster OIDC discovery document and token signature.
steps.why_traversal: Cryptographic proof that request originated inside authorized GKE cluster.

steps.title: Token Generation
steps.action: IAM Credentials API generates ephemeral 3600-second bearer token.
steps.why_traversal: Ephemeral tokens mean zero credential leakage risk if container memory dumps.

steps.title: Authorized API Dispatch
steps.action: Container presents access token to Secret Manager; secret payload is returned.
steps.why_traversal: Fine-grained secret retrieval over encrypted Google private transport.

scenarios.label: Leaked Static Key Attempt
scenarios.root_cause: Legacy developer attempted to authenticate using downloaded service-account-key.json.
scenarios.blast_radius: Key-based attack vectors completely nullified across organization.
scenarios.recovery: Standardize all pipelines on Workload Identity Federation.
